scenario: LSER.7.6.1 positive control for LSER.7.6.1_composite_key_needs_by, on the same schema: naming `(by: sensor)` resolves the identity, so what the sibling refuses is the omission and not the composite key itself. Without the pair, a refusal caused by the schema's shape would read the same.
rules_ds:
use default

schema Reading scope logical:
    site: String key
    sensor: String key
    state: Float mutable

series Reading.state (by: sensor):
    mean sliding 10_min

rule r:
    Reading x where x.mean > 5.0
->
    log info "high"
